# ckbadger

 ckbadger is a CKB blockchain explorer.

Primary markdown rule:

- Append `.md` to any page URL to get a markdown representation.
- Markdown frontmatter includes `buildVersion`.
- Example: `/blocks/123.md`, `/tx/0x....md`, `/charts/hash-rate.md`.

Machine-friendly endpoints:

- API base: `/api/v1`
- Markdown pages: `/{page}.md`
- Raw pages: `/{page}.raw`
  - Optional profile: `?profile=default|debugger`
  - Example: `/tx/0x....raw?profile=debugger`
  - Example: `/identities/dotbit/{identityId}.raw`
  - Example: `/identities/did/{identityId}.raw`
  - Example: `/objects/mnft/{objectId}.raw`
  - `profile=debugger` returns `mockTransaction` for `ckb-debugger --tx-file`
  - `/tx/{hash}.raw` also includes `data.txWitness` (witness analyses + inference)
  - Raw response `meta` includes `buildVersion`
  - Raw response headers: `x-ckbadger-format`, `x-ckbadger-profile`, `x-ckbadger-schema`
- Capability descriptor: `/capabilities` (JSON)

Core page groups:

- `/blocks`, `/blocks/{id}`
- `/transactions`, `/tx/{hash}`
- `/address/{addr}`, `/cell/{txHash-outputIndex}`
- `/tokens`, `/tokens/{typeHash}`
- `/inventory/tokens`, `/inventory/objects`, `/inventory/identities`
- `/objects/{sporeId}`, `/identities/dotbit/{identityId}`, `/identities/did/{identityId}`, `/objects/mnft/{objectId}`
- `/scripts`, `/scripts/{name}`, `/script/{codeHash}`
- `/dao`, `/dao/charts`
- `/charts`, `/charts/{slug}`
- `/forks`, `/forks/{id}`
- `/hardforks`

For a fuller capability map see: `/llms-full.txt`
